Question: Respected Mufti Sb my younger brother is 24 years old unmarried man who is punctual of Namaz. He is suffering from NIGHT FALL PROBLEM(EHATLAM) from a long time. He get Night Fall 3-4 time in a week, which make him irritate to have bath in night time. He was in India 10 months back and had some medicine for relief but could not get relief now he is in Iraq. To get any type of medicine is very hard here. Daily before sleep he read Alhmdo Sharif, Ayatul Kursi, 4 Kul and some other duae but problem is there. It is be requested if you could give some Specific Dua to get relief for this sickness. Answer ID: 8273 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1745/1646=D/1429) Recite Surah Tariq before going to bed, in-sha-Allah it will be beneficial. After returning to India , consult any expert Hakim or get homeopathic treatment.
